items.computation: The invoice is dated 16.10.2026 (Friday), and payment is due 'within 8 days from the invoice date'. For a period triggered by an event/date (not the day itself), § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes the day of the event, so counting starts on 17.10.2026. Counting 8 days: 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 October 2026 → the 8-day period ends on 24.10.2026 (Saturday). Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a declaration or performance falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period extends to the next working day. 24.10.2026 is a Saturday and 25.10.2026 is a Sunday, so the due date moves to Monday, 26.10.2026 (no NW public holiday intervenes).
